title.zh: 复盘：试玩留下了什么可修改的信息
title.en: Review what a trial leaves open to revision

paragraphs.zh: 沿用纸上寻宝，先试一个线索，再写“这一步看清了什么”和“还没替大家决定什么”。若规则缺失，先问清，不把开始本身当更好。可以只画路线。复盘关注下一位是否还能改玩法，而非谁最先行动；停止、等待或换分工都不证明缺乏勇气，也不需用更大风险延续角色感。
paragraphs.en: For the paper treasure hunt, try one clue and state what it clarified and what remains undecided for the group. Ask about missing rules without treating starting as automatically better. Sketch a route only if preferred. Review room for the next person to change the game rather than who acted first. Stopping, waiting or changing roles establishes no lack of courage and needs no escalation of risk.

title.zh: 借虚构社团活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined fan-club activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸上寻宝只先试一个线索，你会试哪一步，再把哪些决定留给大家？”各拟一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或熟悉全部剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a paper treasure hunt began with one clue, which step would you try and which decisions would you leave to the group?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or knowing the entire story.

Seven names concern this edition’s options, assigning no house and assessing no magic, intelligence, courage or compatibility. The other person may change characters, disagree, decline or stop. Do not assign fictional experiences or actions to real people or assess someone absent.

title.zh: 复盘：来源与添写都能被辨认
title.en: Review a visible boundary between source and invention

paragraphs.zh: 沿用虚构物件的两种解释，给一条写出文本依据，给另一条标“我们为游戏新编”。若没有找到依据，就保留未知，不靠肯定语气补齐。只改短笔记即可。复盘看读者能否区分引用与创作，而非资料收集多少；把自编版本用于游戏不必冒充原作，也不需要为每个随意点子做穷尽研究。
paragraphs.en: For two explanations of an invented object, attach a textual basis to one and mark another as newly made for the game. Leave an unfound basis unknown instead of adding certainty. Revise a short note. Review whether a reader can distinguish source and invention rather than the amount collected. A game can use an invented version without claiming canon or researching every casual idea exhaustively.

title.zh: 借虚构社团活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined fan-club activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果同人册子混着原文与新点子，你会怎样标一处来源和一处添写，让两者都能继续被讨论？”各拟一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或熟悉全部剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a fan booklet mixed source details and new ideas, how would you label one of each while keeping both open for discussion?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or knowing the entire story.

title.zh: 复盘：共同等待也有安静版本
title.en: Review a quiet option within shared waiting

paragraphs.zh: 沿用游戏开场前的等待，想一个轻松聊天版本和一个各自读书但可同坐的版本。先问偏好，不要求别人解释为何不想说话，自己也可选安静。可以只想象邀请。复盘看时间是否自在、拒绝是否容易，不以笑声和发言量评友情；你不必负责填满每一分钟，也不必永久当活跃气氛的人。
paragraphs.en: For the wait before a game, imagine an easy chat and reading separately while sharing a seat. Ask about preferences without requiring reasons for quietness, including your own. Imagine the invitation only. Review comfortable time and easy refusal without grading friendship through laughter or talk. You need neither fill every minute nor remain responsible for keeping the group lively.

title.zh: 借虚构社团活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined fan-club activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果游戏还要等朋友到齐，你会怎样邀请聊聊，同时给想安静读书的人留位置？”各拟一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或熟悉全部剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “While waiting for everyone before a game, how would you invite conversation and leave room for quiet reading?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or knowing the entire story.

title.zh: 复盘：换分工也说清交接
title.en: Review a chosen role with a clear handover

paragraphs.zh: 沿用开放日从旧分工转去写导览，分别说想试什么、旧部分需要谁接、愿意适应什么限制。换角色需共同安排，不等于你必须先做完所有旧任务才可表达。只改虚构分工表也行。复盘看自己的选择是否被听见、接力是否清楚；不把得到新角色当自信分数，也不把未能换成看作个人声音无效。
paragraphs.en: For moving from a previous open-day role to writing a tour note, name the desired part, the handover and constraints you could adapt to. A change needs agreement without requiring completion of every old task before speaking. Revise a fictional roster. Review a heard preference and a clear handover without grading confidence through getting the role or treating an unchanged assignment as an invalid voice.

title.zh: 借虚构社团活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined fan-club activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果开放日大家默认你做旧分工，你会怎样提出想写导览，再和伙伴约清交接？”各拟一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或熟悉全部剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If people assumed your previous open-day role, how would you ask to write a tour note and agree the handover?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or knowing the entire story.

title.zh: 复盘：小版本是否真的更好进入
title.en: Review whether a smaller version helps entry

paragraphs.zh: 沿用植物纸手工，把第一轮缩为一片叶子，再检查材料和说明是否合适。小一点仍不方便，可以换纸、看示范或不做，不用继续缩小来证明努力。可以只看步骤。复盘关注准备如何影响体验，不与熟手比较；这次喜欢小版本不让别人有权永远给你简单分工，也不预示学习速度或潜力。
paragraphs.en: For the plant paper craft, reduce a first round to one leaf and check the materials and instructions. If that remains awkward, change paper, watch a demonstration or stop without continually shrinking the task to prove effort. Review steps only if preferred. Examine the setup without comparisons to experienced people. Enjoying a small version neither authorises permanent easy assignments nor predicts learning speed or potential.

title.zh: 借虚构社团活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined fan-club activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果植物纸手工先只做一片叶子，你会检查什么条件，再决定继续、换法或结束？”各拟一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或熟悉全部剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a plant paper craft started with one leaf, what would you check before continuing, adapting or stopping?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or knowing the entire story.

title.zh: 复盘：两个虚构解释，不必争唯一真相
title.en: Review two fictional explanations without a truth contest

paragraphs.zh: 沿用图上未解释的印记，编两个不同说明，都标成“本次游戏的可能设定”。选一种、合并或都不用，都可以；若谈原作含义，则另查文本证据。可以只起两个名字。复盘看点子是否打开下一幕，不用奇特程度证明创造力，也不把虚构解释当作者意图、现实事实或超自然洞察。
paragraphs.en: For the unexplained mark in a picture, invent two explanations and label both as possible settings for this game. Choose, combine or ignore them; claims about the original text need separate evidence. Name two possibilities only if preferred. Review openings for the next scene without proving creativity through oddness or treating invention as authorial intention, reality or supernatural insight.

title.zh: 借虚构社团活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined fan-club activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果故事插图有个未解释的印记，你会编哪两种可能，又怎样标清这是这次游戏的新设定？”各拟一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或熟悉全部剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For an unexplained mark in a story picture, which two possibilities would you invent and how would you label them as new game settings?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or knowing the entire story.

title.zh: 复盘：欢迎是否留下可用的选择
title.en: Review usable choices within a welcome

paragraphs.zh: 沿用没带用品的社团新人，先指出可借物和下一步，再问想试、先看还是稍后加入。能提供多少也说清，不默默承担全部准备。可以只画桌面说明。复盘看选择是否容易使用，而非别人是否马上加入或感谢；安静、离开或自带别的材料都可正常，不需从结果推断照顾型人格或接待技能。
paragraphs.en: For the newcomer without supplies, show borrowable items and the next step, then ask about trying, watching or joining later. State what you can provide without taking on every preparation. Sketch a table guide only. Review usable choices rather than immediate participation or thanks. Quietness, leaving or different materials can all fit without inferring a caring personality or hospitality skill.

title.zh: 借虚构社团活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined fan-club activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果新人没带用品又不清楚安排，你会先说明哪两件事，并留下哪些加入或旁观的选择？”各拟一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加活动、公开经历或熟悉全部剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a newcomer had no supplies or clear plan, which two things would you explain and what options to join or watch would you leave?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or knowing the entire story.
